name: Assteroid Belt
description: A shattered planet's worth of rock, a station that has never once been empty, and rules that stop at the airlock. Everything out here is for sale and nothing out here is free.
flavor: Hard vacuum outside, harder crew inside. The Belt does not care which one you came for.
Station 8008135 is the only berth for half a billion kilometres in any direction, and she has never once been empty.
